timeline.text: Archaeologists opening an untouched Egyptian coffin found a mummy frozen in a blood-curdling scream.
In 1935, researchers in Luxor unearthed a sealed wooden sarcophagus containing an ancient woman with her jaw locked wide open in utter agony.
Modern CT scans revealed no sign of violent struggle, yet her body was embalmed with her mouth pinned open—a direct violation of ancient burial rites.
Why would embalmers intentionally preserve someone in eternal terror, making you wonder why...

script_title: The Mystery of the Lighthouse Keepers
pin_comment: What do you think really happened to the 3 keepers? Rogue wave or something unexplainable? 👇

timeline.text: In 1900, three lighthouse keepers vanished from a remote island without leaving a single trace.
When a supply ship arrived at the Flannan Isles, the lighthouse was dead dark. Inside, rescuers found an untouched meal on the table and a clock stopped on the wall.
The heavy iron gates were locked, two oilskins were missing, and the logbook ended with an entry describing a storm that never happened according to nearby ships.
How could three experienced men vanish from a locked island in clear weather, leaving us to wonder how...
